# Living Water Pressure Wash Services

> Living Water Pressure Wash Services Ltd. is a pressure washing, sandblasting and surface restoration company serving Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area (Ontario, Canada) since 1998. It cleans and restores residential, commercial, industrial and heritage properties, has completed 7,500+ projects, carries $5M commercial general liability insurance, is WSIB covered and ISSA-GBAC certified, and is rated 4.9/5 on Google.

## Key facts
- Founded: 1998 (28 years in business)
- Headquarters / service base: Toronto, Ontario, Canada
- Phone (main office): (416) 663-8000
- Toll free: 1-833-456-2978
- 24/7 emergency line: (647) 833-4343
- Email: info@livingwater-pws.com
- Website: https://livingwater-pws.com/
- Booking: residential jobs typically within 2–5 days; free assessment and fixed written quote; re-clean guarantee
- Service area: Toronto, North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke, East York, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Woodbridge, Maple, Kleinburg, Richmond Hill, Markham, King City, Aurora, Newmarket, Georgina, Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa, Oakville, Burlington, Milton, Hamilton, Guelph, Cambridge, St. Catharines, Niagara Falls, Barrie, Simcoe County

## Services
- [Residential Power Washing](https://livingwater-pws.com/residential-power-washing/): Living Water cleans the outside of homes across Toronto and the GTA — driveways, interlock, patios, brick, stone, stucco, siding, roofs, decks and fences — using low-pressure soft washing with biodegradable cleaners where high pressure would damage siding, mortar or window seals.
- [Commercial Power Washing](https://livingwater-pws.com/commercial-power-washing/): Living Water provides commercial pressure washing across Toronto and the GTA for retail plazas, office buildings, parking lots and garages, schools, restaurants, warehouses and construction sites — removing gum, grease, graffiti and stains while keeping the property open and safe.
- [Industrial Power Washing](https://livingwater-pws.com/industrial-power-washing/): Living Water provides industrial pressure washing and hydro jetting across Ontario — cleaning silos and tanks inside and out, manufacturing and food plants, bridges and dams, condenser pipes and heavy equipment — with safety-first planning and 24/7 emergency response.
- [Sandblasting & Media Blasting](https://livingwater-pws.com/sandblasting-services/): Living Water offers mobile dustless sandblasting, wet and dry abrasive blasting, micro blasting, soda blasting and dry ice blasting across Toronto and the GTA to remove rust, scale, paint and epoxy from steel, aluminium, brick, concrete and pools.
- [Brick Cleaning & Paint Removal](https://livingwater-pws.com/brick-cleaning-paint-removal/): Living Water cleans brick and removes paint from interior and exterior masonry across Toronto and the GTA, choosing between chemical cleaning, controlled pressure washing and abrasive blasting after assessing the brick and the coating — so mortar, windows and plants are protected.
- [Historical Remediation](https://livingwater-pws.com/historical-remediation/): Living Water restores historic buildings, statues and landmarks in Toronto and Ontario using heritage-appropriate methods — steam cleaning, soda and micro blasting, wet and dry sandblasting, and lead paint removal — with a working knowledge of the brick, stone and metals used in Canadian construction over the past century.
- [Disaster Restoration](https://livingwater-pws.com/disaster-restoration/): Living Water provides 24/7 disaster restoration across Toronto and the GTA — fire and smoke damage cleaning, water extraction and drying, wind and storm damage securing and repair, and mould remediation — restoring homes and businesses to their pre-loss condition. Emergency line: (647) 833-4343.
- [Elevator Pit Cleaning](https://livingwater-pws.com/elevator-pit-cleaning/): Living Water cleans and sanitizes elevator pits across Toronto and the GTA — pressure washing, sludge and oil spill removal, hazardous waste disposal, crack repair, painting, deodorizing and sewage backup clean-up — and is a trusted referral for major Ontario elevator service companies.
- [Efflorescence Removal](https://livingwater-pws.com/efflorescence-removal/): Efflorescence is the white, powdery salt deposit left when moisture moves through masonry and evaporates. Living Water removes it from brick, natural stone, concrete and interlock across Toronto and the GTA, and is trusted as the warranty service provider for many Ontario stone manufacturers.
- [Graffiti Removal](https://livingwater-pws.com/graffiti-removal/): Living Water removes graffiti from brick, concrete, stone, metal and glass across Toronto and the GTA — usually within the same week — using bio-friendly chemical removers and controlled pressure washing selected for the surface, and can apply anti-graffiti coatings afterwards.
- [Stone Restoration](https://livingwater-pws.com/stone-restoration/): Living Water cleans and restores natural stone — marble, granite, limestone, sandstone and precast — on homes, commercial buildings and heritage properties across Toronto and the GTA, removing stains, mineral deposits and organic growth with methods matched to the stone.
- [Metal Restoration](https://livingwater-pws.com/metal-restoration/): Living Water restores metal surfaces across Toronto and the GTA — removing rust, oxidation, old paint and coatings from steel, stainless steel, aluminium and copper — using cleaning, sandblasting or media blasting chosen for the metal and the finish required.

## FAQ
**How quickly can Living Water start?**
Residential jobs are usually booked within 2–5 days, and same-week service is standard. Commercial and industrial clients get 24/7 emergency response on (647) 833-4343.

**Are you licensed and insured?**
Yes. Living Water is fully licensed in Ontario, carries $5 million in commercial general liability insurance, is WSIB covered and ISSA-GBAC certified. We send a Certificate of Insurance to your property manager, condo board or HOA on request.

**Will pressure washing damage my driveway, brick or siding?**
Not when it is done right. We match the pressure, nozzle, water temperature and chemistry to each surface — interlock, brick, vinyl, stucco, stone and wood all need different approaches. Where high pressure is wrong we soft wash, steam or use media blasting instead.

**Do you do commercial and industrial work?**
Yes — refineries, plants, silos and tanks, heritage restoration, graffiti removal, sandblasting and elevator pit cleaning. Many of our clients are property managers, general contractors and municipalities. Our crews are certified boom and scissor lift operators.

**What areas do you serve?**
Toronto and the entire Greater Toronto Area, including Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill, Oakville, Burlington, Pickering, Ajax, Whitby and Oshawa, plus Hamilton, Niagara, Guelph, Cambridge, Barrie and Simcoe County.

**Is the quote free?**
Yes. Assessments are free and no-obligation, and you receive a fixed written quote before any work starts.
